reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 80,450.0. That is 722.3 points under spot, 1.53 hourly ATRs on a 472.86 reading, and it sits 53.9 points BENEATH the 80,503.9 session low rather than on it. The midnight gate at 80,550 was wicked by 46.1 points at 08:00 UTC and the hour still settled at 81,156.8 - the level held on a settle and failed on a wick, exactly the distinction the endday lesson was written about. The new gate steps down under that proven wick so the same sweep cannot arm it twice. A settled close under 80,450 means the 80,500 to 80,750 shelf, where 1,951,540 USD of LONGS have been cleared in the last 16.4 hours, has been given up on a close.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 81,450.0, held unchanged from the midnight frame. It still sits 45.0 points ABOVE the session high of 81,405.0 - the market came within 45 points of arming it at 11:00 UTC and settled 81,225.9, 224.1 points short. The gate stays where it is precisely because it did its job: it refused to arm on a wick that failed. Above it the 81,500 and 81,750 shelves hold 3,865,531 USD of mostly short liquidations and the road opens toward the 82,000 magnet.

decisionBox.changed: Position stays ADD and the bias stays range-with-a-bullish-tilt, but the internals firmed. Three things changed. One: the midnight reduce gate at 80,550 was TESTED and held - price wicked 80,503.9 and the hour closed 652.9 points higher at 81,156.8, then printed three consecutive rising settled closes (81,055.0, 81,181.2, 81,225.9). The floor is now a proven floor, so the reduce gate steps down to 80,450, under the wick. Two: the 1H MACD histogram is still negative but has narrowed to -113.88 from -134.31, and 15m momentum has flipped positive at +28.33 from -16.01 - the timeframe disagreement the midnight report flagged is closing, from the fast end up. Three: the counterweight, and it is the reason confidence only moves from 6.25 to 6.50. Open interest FELL another 38,471,957 USD to 2,352,056,689 while price ROSE 248.7 points. Falling open interest with rising price is short covering, not fresh long demand - the bounce is being paid for by shorts closing, and that fuel is finite. The resting stop switches OFF: the endday session proved a resting order at the same level as a settled-close trigger fills on the noise a close filters out, and price is now 722.3 points above the trigger with a proven floor between. Confidence 6.50.

2,400,391 USD total, 2,277,911 of it short. The lower lip of the 82,000 pocket - once price closes through here the gap to the main magnet has almost nothing in it.
1,878,696 USD total, 1,587,620 short. First real overhead friction, 327.7 points above spot, and the shelf the 81,450 add gate is designed to clear.
1,069,902 USD total, 922,952 short. Only 77.7 points above spot - thin enough that it is a speed bump rather than a wall.
1,566,536 USD total and the polarity flips here: 1,135,900 of it is LONG. The first level below spot where longs, not shorts, are the ones being carried out.

1,525,904 USD, 1,514,398 of it long - the cleanest long-liquidation shelf on the map and the level the midnight report identified as the downside magnet. It has since been defended: price traded under it to 80,503.9 and reclaimed it inside the hour.
437,142 USD, all long, printed on the 08:00 UTC sweep to 80,503.9. Small, and it is the tail of a flush that was immediately bought.

calibration.note: The midnight frame is now resolved and both gates were right. The 80,550.0 reduce gate did NOT fire: price wicked to 80,503.9 at 08:00 UTC, 46.1 points through the level, and the SAME HOUR closed 81,156.8 - a 652.9-point recovery inside one bar. The lowest settled hourly close since the midnight read is 80,650.0, exactly 100.0 points of clearance. The 81,450.0 add gate did NOT arm either: the session high reached 81,405.0 at 11:00 UTC, 45.0 points short, and that hour settled 81,225.9. The 80,450.0 resting stop the midnight session recommended was NOT touched - price came within 53.9 points of it. That is the direct payoff of the endday lesson: the same 80,450-to-80,550 zone was crossed by a wick and honoured by every close, and because the stop was placed below the trigger rather than at it, nothing was stopped out. The discretionary side also worked, modestly: the midnight ADD executed 20 USDT of spot at 80,923.6 and marks 81,172.3, +248.7 points or +0.31 percent, roughly +0.06 USDT on the size.
